page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.6xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 24 dedicated vCPUs derived from 12 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. No local storage or GPU accelerators are bundled with this instance type, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance profile. Single-core processing capabilities are relatively weak, as shown by stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25%, and single-threaded gzip compression ranking in the bottom 10%. However, multi-core performance scales to average levels, with Geekbench multi-core, PassMark CPU, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression scores all positioning in the middle 50%. Memory bandwidth tests show stable average performance, with read-only large block speeds at 96.89 GB/sec and write speeds at 52.55 GB/sec.

Given the high memory density and average multi-core performance, this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound workloads that do not require intense single-threaded compute power. It is well-suited for database operations, caching layers like Redis (which achieved 16.8 million operations per second in testing), static web serving, and moderate multi-threaded data processing. It is less suitable for workloads requiring high single-core throughput or local NVMe storage.
